title: modadd checkpoint: no modular-addition behaviour to explain (null result)
label: no behaviour - null result
behavior: Claimed: a 1-layer transformer that reads [a, b, =] with a, b in 0..112 and outputs (a + b) mod 113 at the last position.
summary: The loaded checkpoint (benchmarks/modadd/model/model.pt, local-full, full precision; 1 layer, 4 heads, d_model 128) does not perform the claimed behaviour. On the full 113x113 grid its accuracy is 0.0086 (110 of 12769), indistinguishable from chance (1/113 = 0.0088), and the mean logit difference between the correct answer and a wrong answer is -0.0001 (std 0.157). The investigation was stopped after the baseline, as the protocol requires: there is no mechanism to recover, and no algorithm, circuit or verification is reported.

claims.text: On the full 113x113 grid the model's accuracy at predicting (a + b) mod 113 is 0.008615 (110/12769), at chance level (1/113 = 0.00885). Backend: local-full, full precision. Pre-registered prediction (accuracy <= 0.05) confirmed.

The model has no logit preference for the correct answer: mean logit difference (correct minus incorrect) is -0.0001 with std 0.157 on clean prompts, the same as on corrupt prompts (-0.0003). Backend: local-full.

limitations: Only the behaviour was measured (3 of 40 experiments). No experiment looked inside the model, so this report says nothing about why it fails: untrained or randomly initialised weights, a wrong or corrupted checkpoint file, and a loading mismatch are all untested explanations.
verify_hypothesis was not run because there is no hypothesis about a mechanism to verify.
The first four example predictions in E0003 were all token 13, hinting at a near-constant output; the distribution of predictions over the whole grid was not analysed.
open_questions: Is this the intended checkpoint? The task description says the model was trained from scratch to do this task, which the measurements contradict.
Do the weights carry any structure at all (weights_svd, periodicity of W_E), or are they indistinguishable from an initialisation?
overall_status: unverified (no verification run) · no behaviour - null result
